dayTrips.meta_description: Private day tour from Colombo to Sigiriya Lion Rock and Dambulla Cave Temple, both UNESCO sites. Private vehicle, guide and entrance fees included.
dayTrips.overview: Sigiriya is a 5th-century rock fortress rising around 200 metres above the surrounding plain, with royal gardens, the famous Mirror Wall and ancient frescoes near its summit — a UNESCO World Heritage Site and one of Sri Lanka's most recognisable landmarks. Nearby, the Dambulla Royal Cave Temple, also UNESCO-listed, holds a series of Buddhist cave shrines painted and sculpted over more than a thousand years. Both sites sit in the island's Cultural Triangle, roughly 170km from Colombo.

Many day visits from Colombo also call at the Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage en route. Kandy is roughly 115km from Colombo, a journey of about three hours by road.
